description: Welcome to this charming ranch-style home with pristine curb appeal featuring a stamped concrete driveway, tastefully designed landscape, and a covered front porch! The heart of this home is an open-plan kitchen, seamlessly integrating with the living room. The gourmet kitchen complete with granite counters, ample storage, stainless appliances, and island.  Entertain in the generous sized living room with vaulted ceilings and large windows bringing in natural light. The primary retreat boasts a spa like bathroom with dual sinks and private shower. Secondary rooms are conveniently located near the updated hall bathroom with a walk in shower and custom vanity. Beyond the interior, the property invites you to the outdoors with a covered stamped concrete patio, lush landscape, banana and nectarine trees, and storage shed. Other seller updates include newer ducting and insulation, windows, covered patio with lighting, and laminate flooring. Desirable location offers close proximity to Midtown, nature trails, Sac State, water activities, parks, schools, local eateries, entertainment and shopping! Welcome home!
